evidence.title: Mabel Greer's Toyshop
evidence.text: Mabel Greer's Toyshop are an English progressive rock (initially as psychedelic rock) band formed in London, active from 1966 to 1968 that was the precursor to the rock band Yes.

evidence.title: Mabel Greer's Toyshop
evidence.text: Their music was marked by a combination of psychedelic, American blues and classically influenced arrangements with poetic lyrics.

evidence.title: Mabel Greer's Toyshop
evidence.text: Members included Chris Squire, Peter Banks, Tony Kaye, Bill Bruford, and Jon Anderson.

evidence.title: Mabel Greer's Toyshop
evidence.text: The band reformed in 2014 with original members, singer and guitarist Clive Bayley and drummer Robert Hagger, along with Hugo Barré, Tony Kaye, and Billy Sherwood.

evidence.title: 500 Days of Summer
evidence.text: 500 Days of Summer (stylized as (500) Days of Summer) is a 2009 American romantic comedy-drama film directed by Marc Webb from a screenplay written by Scott Neustadter and Michael H. Weber, and produced by Mark Waters.

evidence.title: 500 Days of Summer
evidence.text: The film stars Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel, and employs a nonlinear narrative structure, with the story based upon its male protagonist and his memories of a failed relationship.

evidence.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
evidence.text: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 (also released as The Amazing Spider-Man 2: Rise of Electro in some markets) is a 2014 American superhero film featuring the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man.

evidence.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
evidence.text: The film was directed by Marc Webb and was produced by Avi Arad and Matt Tolmach.

evidence.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2

evidence.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2

evidence.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2

evidence.title: Marc Webb
evidence.text: Marc Preston Webb (born August 31, 1974) is an American music video, short film, and film director.

evidence.title: Marc Webb
evidence.text: He made his feature film directorial debut with the 2009 romantic comedy-drama "(500) Days of Summer", and went on to direct the 2012 "Spider-Man" reboot "The Amazing Spider-Man", its 2014 sequel, "The Amazing Spider-Man 2", and the 2017 comedy-drama films "Gifted" and "The Only Living Boy in New York".

evidence.title: Tony Kaye (musician)
evidence.text: Tony Kaye (born Anthony John Selvidge, 11 January 1946) is an English keyboardist and songwriter.

evidence.title: Tony Kaye (musician)
evidence.text: Kaye was the original keyboard player for the progressive rock group Yes, from 1968 to 1971, and toured with David Bowie from 1975 to 76 for the "Station to Station" tour.

evidence.title: Tony Kaye (musician)
evidence.text: He rejoined Yes from 1983 to 1995.

evidence.title: Tony Kaye (musician)
evidence.text: Between his stints with Yes, he was also a founder member of the 1970s rock bands Badger and Detective, and joined Badfinger for their last album in 1981.

evidence.title: Tony Kaye (musician)
evidence.text: Kaye currently plays with CIRCA:, which also features Yes member Billy Sherwood, and formerly included Yes drummer Alan White.

evidence.title: Tony Kaye (musician)
evidence.text: Kaye was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of Yes in 2017.
